summary: A generative groovebox in the style of early-90s PC tracker music: six lanes compose chords, bass, melodies, drums and effects live in a chosen style, and you mix and blend styles rather than programming steps.
features: Six lanes: lead, arp, pad, bass, drums and sfx
Eighteen styles, queued, blended lane by lane or launched at once
Per-lane filter, wobble, drive and tracker effects like slide and vibrato
Song form with intro, drop, end and an optional energy arc
Edit page for your own parts, up to 512 bars, with live recording
Demo-style visuals and scopes; patched for FM-1 units with the new chipset
